# Futures: REST API Reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/sync-docs.mjs on 2026-10-26 from https://massive.com/docs/llms.txt. Do not edit by hand. -->

9 REST endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Aggregates

### Aggregate Bars (OHLC)

`GET /futures/v1/aggs/{ticker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/futures/aggregates.md)

Retrieve historical OHLC (open, high, low, close) and volume bars for a futures contract over a date range.

- **Params:** `ticker`\*, `resolution`, `window_start` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `close dollar_volume high low open session_end_date settlement_price ticker transactions volume window_start` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic 8-hour historical · Starter–Developer 10-min delayed · Advanced Real-time · history Basic–Starter 2y · Developer 5y · Advanced all

## Contracts

### Contracts

`GET /futures/v1/contracts` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/futures/contracts.md)

The Contracts API provides a single source for discovering all listed futures contracts and retrieving complete contract specifications.

- **Params:** `date` (.gt .gte .lt .lte), `product_code` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `provider_id`, `provider_product_id`, `ticker` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `active`, `type` (.any_of), `first_trade_date` (.gt .gte .lt .lte), `last_trade_date` (.gt .gte .lt .lte), `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `active date days_to_maturity first_trade_date group_code last_trade_date max_order_quantity min_order_quantity name product_code provider_id provider_product_id settlement_date settlement_tick_size spread_tick_size ticker trade_tick_size trading_venue type` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated daily · history Basic–Starter 2y · Developer 5y · Advanced all

## Market Operations

### Exchanges

`GET /futures/v1/exchanges` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/futures/market-operations/exchanges.md)

Retrieve a list of supported futures exchanges, including their unique exchange codes, names, and other important details.

- **Params:** `limit`
- **Returns:** results[]: `acronym id locale mic name operating_mic type url` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated as needed

### Market Status

`GET /futures/v1/market-status` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/futures/market-operations/market-status.md)

Retrieve the current market status for a specific product or products.

- **Params:** `product_code` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `limit`
- **Returns:** results[]: `market_event name product_code session_end_date timestamp trading_venue` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated in real time

## Products

### Products

`GET /futures/v1/products` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/futures/products.md)

The Products API is a unified source for discovering all supported futures products and retrieving full product specifications.

- **Params:** `name` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `product_code` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `provider_id`, `date` (.gt .gte .lt .lte), `trading_venue` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `sector` (.any_of), `sub_sector` (.any_of), `asset_class` (.any_of), `asset_sub_class` (.any_of), `type` (.any_of), `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `asset_class asset_sub_class clearing_symbol clearing_venue date last_updated name price_quotation product_code provider_id sector settlement_currency_code settlement_method settlement_type strategy_type sub_sector trade_currency_code trading_venue type unit_of_measure unit_of_measure_qty` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated daily · history Basic–Starter 2y · Developer 5y · Advanced all

## Schedules

### Schedules

`GET /futures/v1/schedules` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/futures/schedules.md)

The Schedules API provides a unified way to retrieve trading schedules for futures markets, returning precise session open and close times, intraday breaks, and any adjustments for holidays or special events.

- **Params:** `product_code` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `session_end_date` (.gt .gte .lt .lte), `trading_venue` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `event product_code product_name session_end_date timestamp trading_venue` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated daily · history Basic–Developer 2y · Advanced all

## Snapshots

### Futures Contracts Snapshot

`GET /futures/v1/snapshot` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/futures/snapshots/contracts-snapshot.md)

Retrieve real-time snapshots for a set of futures contracts, including key market data such as the latest trade, quote, session metrics (open, high, low, close, volume), and settlement prices.

- **Params:** `product_code` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `ticker` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `details last_minute last_quote last_trade session` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Developer 10-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

## Trades & Quotes

### Quotes

`GET /futures/v1/quotes/{ticker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/futures/trades-quotes/quotes.md)

Retrieve quote data for a specified futures contract ticker.

- **Params:** `timestamp` (.gt .gte .lt .lte), `session_end_date`, `limit`, `sort`, `ticker`\*
- **Returns:** results[]: `ask_price ask_size ask_timestamp bid_price bid_size bid_timestamp channel report_sequence sequence_number session_end_date ticker timestamp` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Developer+ · recency Developer 10-min delayed · Advanced Real-time · history Developer 5y · Advanced all

### Trades

`GET /futures/v1/trades/{ticker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/futures/trades-quotes/trades.md)

Retrieve comprehensive, tick-level trade data for a specified futures contract ticker over a defined time range.

- **Params:** `timestamp` (.gt .gte .lt .lte), `session_end_date`, `limit`, `sort`, `ticker`\*
- **Returns:** results[]: `channel price report_sequence sequence_number session_end_date size ticker timestamp` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Developer+ · recency Developer 10-min delayed · Advanced Real-time · history Developer 5y · Advanced all
